headerDisplay: BTicino HOMETOUCH video door entry for Apple Home: ring notifications, live view with two-way audio, one lock per entrance. Sign in once with a dedicated Door Entry account; the plugin runs everything else.

entrances.title: Entrances
entrances.description: One lock per entrance appears inside the doorbell. The address is the entrance panel's lock address (usually 20 for the first, 21 for the second).

enableTwoWayAudio.title: Answer rings from the live view (reserve the call)
enableTwoWayAudio.description: When someone rings, opening the doorbell's live view attaches to that call instead of starting a separate one. Pressing 'Parla' then reserves the call (like answering in the Door Entry app): the entrance panel and the family app stop ringing and nobody else can take it. Several people can watch the ring at the same time; only the first to press 'Parla' talks. Needs the entrance panel's two-way audio.

secondCamera.title: Second camera of the entrance panel (when the system has one)
secondCamera.description: The camera the Door Entry app reaches with its arrow. It appears as a separate camera in Apple Home.

connectionSensor.title: HOMETOUCH connection sensor
connectionSensor.description: A contact sensor that opens when the HOMETOUCH keeps dropping the connection or cannot be reached (rings and entrance opening may then not work until it is restarted). Turn on its notifications in Apple Home.

hksvRecording.title: Record a clip on ring (HomeKit Secure Video)
hksvRecording.description: Records a short clip of the entrance each time someone rings, saved to iCloud and visible in Apple Home even if the ring notification is missed. Requires an iCloud+ plan and a home hub (HomePod/Apple TV), with the camera set to 'Stream & Allow Recording'. The clip has no audio and covers only the ring (no continuous recording).

ringerControls.title: Ringer controls (mute and answering machine)
ringerControls.description: Adds a 'Suoneria muta' switch and a 'Segreteria' switch to the doorbell. They send commands to the HOMETOUCH; the shown state is optimistic (not read back from the device), so a change made on the panel itself is not reflected.

ringerVolume.title: Add ringer volume control (experimental)
ringerVolume.description: Adds a 'Volume suoneria' dimmer. Experimental: the volume mapping is not read back and may need tuning with 'Ringer volume codes'.

ringerVolumeCodes.title: Ringer volume codes (advanced, experimental)
ringerVolumeCodes.description: OpenWebNet volume codes from lowest to highest; the dimmer 0–100% maps across them. Leave empty for the default 0..7 ladder.

enabled.title: Allow the Home Assistant integration to connect

allowedClients.title: Allowed Home Assistant addresses (empty: any on the LAN)

liveRtspUrl.title: Live RTSP URL for Home Assistant (optional, go2rtc)

ipcSocket.title: Listener socket (advanced; for go2rtc or the MQTT bridge, e.g. /tmp/bticino-hometouch.sock)
